GrokV2EditImageGenInput.description:
Grok v2.0 Edit Image. Edits 1–3 source images; "auto" keeps the source aspect ratio.
FAL Endpoint: xai/grok-imagine-image/v2.0/edit

items.description: Either A URL, A DataURL or a Base64 string

images.description: The first image is the source; the remaining images are references.

mask.description: Black edits, white preserves. Must match the source dimensions and contain both regions.

width.description: Custom dimensions override imageSize. Set width and height together.

previewUrl.description: Gets a url that can be used to preview a resized version of the image.

imageMetadata.description: External metadata that will be stored with the image

image.description:
The preprocessed control image. Accepts an AIR URN, a URL, or a base64 data URL; the
orchestrator processes it into a stored blob before the job is dispatched.

mask.description: The inpaint mask image. Required when the preprocessor is Inpaint.

aspectRatio.description: Omit to let Krea choose, e.g. to follow the reference images.

Krea 2 served by Krea's own API. Distinct from `fal`/`krea2` (the same models via FAL) and
from the `comfy`/`krea2` ecosystem, which runs the open weights on our own workers.
